remarks: Welcome to 51 Interlaken Road! Don't miss your opportunity to rent this lovely 3 bedroom, 2 full bath home in North Stamford. The interior is spacious, with a beautiful updated kitchen, central air conditioning, and full lower level including washer and dryer. There is also a great sunroom right off your kitchen leading to the backyard.  Sitting on 1 acre, front and back yards are fenced, providing a safe and private space to relax and play. One-car attached garage. Located just minutes from schools, parks, shopping centers, and dining options. Easy access to major highways and very close proximity to the Stamford Nature Center and Bartlett Arboretum & Gardens.
